defs.def:
/** Read one accepted Brain record of a visible room, whole, as outside data. [read] */
ainkrad.brain.brainAiRecord(args: { room: string; id: string }): { created_at: string; id: string; room: string; sources: string[]; text: string; truncated: boolean; type: string }

/** List accepted Brain decisions of the visible rooms, newest first. [read] */
ainkrad.brain.brainAiDecisions(args: { room?: string; limit?: number }): { records: ({ created_at: string; id: string; room: string; sources: string[]; text: string; truncated: boolean; type: string })[]; rooms_closed: number }

/** List the Brain rooms this AI session may see (its project's, or ones a room's access list names). [read] */
ainkrad.brain.brainAiRooms(): ({ id: string; kind: string; name: string; open: boolean })[]

/** Search the Brain across the rooms this AI session may see: accepted records first, then sources. Texts come back as outside data. [read] */
ainkrad.brain.brainAiSearch(args: { q: string; room?: string; limit?: number }): { hits: ({ id: string; kind: string; room: string; started_at: string; text: string })[]; rooms_closed: number; rooms_searched: number }

/** List accepted project state, open tasks and rules (landmines) of the visible rooms, newest first. [read] */
ainkrad.brain.brainAiProjectState(args: { room?: string; limit?: number }): { records: ({ created_at: string; id: string; room: string; sources: string[]; text: string; truncated: boolean; type: string })[]; rooms_closed: number }

search_tool.description: Search the operations of Ainkrad (sessions, audit, health and more) by words. Returns typed definitions of the best matches.
search_tool.name: ainkrad.search
